from_notes: - **Art. 168(1)(a)** names the bicameral States (AP and Telangana included); **Art. 169** lets **Parliament create or abolish** a Council **by ordinary law** (not an Art. 368 amendment) after the Assembly passes a resolution by a **majority of total membership + two-thirds present and voting**. The AP Council (abolished 1985) was **revived in 2007** under Art. 169; AP's 2020 resolution to abolish it again was **withdrawn in 2021**.
